name: Axiom Sovereign Limousine
description: A ground-level luxury limousine with armor plating, signal jamming, and an interior that costs more than most residential buildings. The Sovereign doesn't fly — it doesn't need to. It moves through traffic because traffic moves out of its way, warned by automated transponders that clear a corridor. Tinted one-way glass, whisper-quiet electric drive, and a passenger compartment that is simultaneously a mobile office, a panic room, and a declaration of absolute power. When a Sovereign rolls through a Tier 1 district, people stop and stare at the closest thing to a god they'll ever see.
cost: Φ180,000 base. Φ350,000 with full security package.
autonomy: Chauffeur-driven with AI backup. Having a human driver is the luxury.
armament: Classified. Armor rated for military small arms. Countermeasure suite. The details are NDA-protected.
common_usage: C-suite corporate transport, diplomatic vehicles, corponation board members.
story_hooks: A Sovereign limousine is found abandoned in The Shelf with the engine running and the passenger compartment sealed from the inside — empty
The chauffeur of a Sovereign has been listening to everything for twenty years and finally decides to talk
